mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification (type, recipient_id, actor_id, target_type, target_id, message, metadata_json, status) VALUES (#{type}, #{recipientId}, #{actorId}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{message}, COALESCE(#{metadataJson}, '{}'), #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT id, type, recipient_id, actor_id, target_type, target_id, message, metadata_json, status, read_at, created_at, updated_at FROM notification WHERE recipient_id = #{recipientId} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notification WHERE recipient_id = #{recipientId} AND read_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE notification SET status = 'READ', read_at = COALESCE(read_at, NOW()), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{notificationId} AND recipient_id = #{recipientId} AND read_at IS NULL
